description: This file defines the TimesheetTimeFormatAPI class which provides an API endpoint for retrieving the timesheet time format configuration in the OrangeHRM system. The class extends Endpoint and implements ResourceEndpoint, utilizing traits and models from the OrangeHRM core API library to handle the 'get' request for time format settings.

classes.name: TimesheetTimeFormatAPI
classes.description: API class providing access to the timesheet time format configuration, primarily implementing the 'get' functionality for this setting.

methods.description: Retrieves the current timesheet time format configuration using the configuration service and returns it wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.
